arguments.summary: The database is experiencing degraded performance, with the pgbouncer service showing 100 connections in use and no worker throughput. The failed_jobs table has a backlog of 1204 entries and 47 malformed rows. The read replica is 12 minutes behind the primary.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Restart the pgbouncer service to clear connections and check the worker processes. Export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem and investigate the cause of the failures to resolve the backlog.
